title: The help text for `-a` describes retries instead of total attempts
body:
`args.rs:354` documents `-a`, the field `cloud_max_join_attempts`, as "allow at most N attempts to recover disjoint clouds". That reads as N retries after a first attempt. nail treats N as the total number of attempts.

## Proposal

Reword the help to say that N counts every attempt, the first included.
close_reason: Commit `944417e` on `dev` rewords the `-a` help: "make at most N cloud search attempts in total", and the long help says N counts the first attempt and must be at least 1. The loop in `cloud_stage.rs` runs `0..max_attempts`, with attempt 0 at the unscaled parameters, which confirms the count.
